mapper.select: SELECT id, date, factor_name, factor_name_zh, category, `value`, shap_value, created_at FROM risk_factor WHERE date = #{param1} ORDER BY ABS(shap_value) DESC
SELECT `date`, category, SUM(ABS(shap_value)) AS total_shap FROM risk_factor WHERE `date` BETWEEN #{param1} AND #{param2} GROUP BY `date`, category ORDER BY `date` ASC, category ASC
